name: deepseek-harness-relay
description: Delegate and monitor DeepSeek Harness work from any MCP agent.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate and monitor DeepSeek Harness tasks.
interface.longDescription: Delegate long-running work to DeepSeek Harness from any MCP agent and monitor native sessions and durable events to completion.
defaultPrompt: Review this workspace only through the plugin's native MCP tools; pass paths and scope, never source contents.
Monitor Harness to completion using native MCP. Never create temporary Node, PowerShell, Python, or shell clients.
If native tools are unavailable, repair installation and reload the updated plugin in a new Codex task.
